destination.title: Brane constructions, charges and dynamics
destination.question: How do branes realize gauge sectors, carry charges, and generate geometric, quantum and cosmological dynamics?
destination.summary: The supplied membership supports a broad navigation family. No original scientific scope statement accompanies the numerical proposal, so its precise boundary cannot be endorsed independently. The overview questions below are new proposals, with finer source-scoped identities retained.

systems: D-branes, NS-branes and M-branes in the supplied string/M-theory settings
Orientifolds, supergravity sources, worldvolume theories and effective brane boundaries
Brane-engineered gauge theories and brane cosmological models
targets: Worldvolume actions, amplitudes and dual descriptions
Holographic dynamics and black-hole degrees of freedom
regimes: Dimensions, supersymmetry, compactness and approximation schemes remain source-specific
Static, time-dependent, nonrelativistic and proposed signature-changing settings remain distinguishable
assumptions: Numerical proximity is candidate provenance, not a physical premise
Conjectural constructions and proposed tests remain conditional
Membership does not require a Swampland interpretation
conventions: Charge definitions, duality dictionaries and boundary conditions are not interchangeable
Overview membership does not imply fine-question equivalence
includes: The supplied outside-source probes when their scientific targets fit
Alternate access to amplitude, topological-string and thermal gauge-theory targets
excludes: A universal consistency criterion inferred from this collection
Certification of complete spectra, global compactifications or cosmological selection from local examples
Unstated equivalences between different source questions

sources.title: K-theory, D-branes and Ramond-Ramond fields

evidence.text: How can geometric KO-homology describe type I D-branes, and how can differential equivariant K-theory encode Ramond–Ramond fields and flux quantization on orbifolds?

sources.title: Exotic Branes in String Theory

evidence.text: How should exotic branes, their monodromy charges and charge conservation be understood, and how can ordinary brane bound states generate non-geometric configurations relevant to black hole microphysics?

sources.title: Non-perturbative quantum effects in stringy degenerate geometries: Vacuum created pair of $(D{\bar D})_3$-brane by a two form

evidence.text: Can an effective geometric-torsion description of a Kalb–Ramond field on a D4-brane produce degenerate four-dimensional brane geometries, identify lower-dimensional D-brane quantum corrections, and motivate an axionic explanation of accelerated expansion?

sources.title: Negative Branes, Supergroups and the Signature of Spacetime

evidence.text: How are negative branes and supergroup gauge theories connected to timelike compactification, dynamical spacetime-signature change and holographic emergence of time? Can protected calculations and dualities supply evidence for their nonperturbative existence?

sources.title: Evidence for non-supersymmetric AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can bulk scalar/graviton decoupling from non-supersymmetric D3 branes provide evidence for non-supersymmetric gauge/gravity correspondence, and can an explicit decoupled throat geometry be identified?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: How does compact-space Ramond-Ramond charge cancellation restrict intersecting-brane gauge theories and chiral matter?

sources.title: Comments on Brane Recombination, Finite Flux Vacua, and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can stable N = 1 brane objects be followed beyond the near-supersymmetric intersection EFT, and how could finiteness criteria extend to other compactifications? The paper identifies these as unresolved problems rather than supplying a general construction.

sources.title: Superhairs on the branes of <math display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>11</mn></math> supergravity

evidence.text: Can extremal membrane and fivebrane backgrounds support linearized gravitino hairs unobtainable by any supersymmetry transformation, carrying nonzero asymptotic supercharges, and can such modes extend to intersecting branes?

sources.title: New analytic solutions of non-SUSY black branes in 10-D heterotic supergravity and the phase transition

evidence.text: Can heterotic supergravity admit analytic black branes with multiple gauge charges, and can their perturbative instabilities identify transitions toward additional black-brane configurations?

sources.title: Selftuning solution of cosmological constant in RS-II model and Goldstone boson

evidence.text: Can a dynamical bulk three-form provide an adjustable integration constant supporting flat four-dimensional slices in an RS-II model without retuning the brane tension, and can its scalar dual have a Goldstone-boson interpretation?

sources.title: Supergravity description of field theories on curved manifolds and a no go theorem

evidence.text: What supergravity geometries describe twisted brane theories flowing across dimensions, and under which assumptions are smooth or suitably singular Randall–Sundrum and de Sitter compactifications excluded?

sources.title: Variations on stability

evidence.text: How do nonabelian transverse D-brane scalars modify BPS equations and stability conditions, and how can the resulting equations be related to brane-antibrane tachyons and superconnections?

sources.title: Space - like branes

evidence.text: Can time-dependent topological defects realize spacelike branes in field theory and string theory, and how are tachyon solitons, timelike-Dirichlet boundary states and charged supergravity solutions related?

sources.title: Recombination of intersecting D-branes and cosmological inflation

evidence.text: Can slightly nonsupersymmetric intersecting branes drive separation-field inflation and recombine into a supersymmetric configuration that still contains intersecting branes?

sources.title: Intersecting brane solutions in string and M theory

evidence.text: Which intersecting-brane configurations preserve supersymmetry, how can their supergravity solutions be constructed and localised, and how do these descriptions illuminate black holes and gauge theories?

sources.title: Brane constructions, conifolds and M theory

evidence.text: How can the conformal theory on N D3-branes at a conifold be derived from an intersecting-brane construction, and how do its geometry, global symmetries and coupling moduli appear after lifting to M-theory?

sources.title: K-theory, D-branes and Ramond-Ramond fields

evidence.text: Review differential characters, Deligne cocycles and differential K-theory represented by map/cochain/form triples. The orbifold construction is announced as using Bredon cohomology and the equivariant Chern character.

sources.title: Exotic Branes in String Theory

evidence.text: Vary Wess–Zumino couplings and use democratic RR field strengths, source-modified Bianchi identities and improved NS5-dependent field strengths to distinguish brane-source currents from conserved Page currents.

sources.title: Non-perturbative quantum effects in stringy degenerate geometries: Vacuum created pair of $(D{\bar D})_3$-brane by a two form

evidence.text: Analyze radial rescalings ρ=r² and R=r⁴, separate terms interpreted as lower-brane corrections, and apply Weyl scalings λ=r² or λ=1/r². Causal patches are rearranged through 2×2 matrix projections, inverse projections and analytic continuation.

sources.title: Negative Branes, Supergroups and the Signature of Spacetime

evidence.text: Compute curvature-correction phases from one-loop KK diagrams with a specified iε prescription. Independently study bosonic Euclidean-worldsheet quantization, T-duality, one-loop modular invariance through Poisson resummation, and analytic continuation of sigma-model couplings.

sources.title: Evidence for non-supersymmetric AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Study potential asymptotics and plotted radial profiles because the general scattering equation is difficult to solve analytically. Separately substitute an alpha-prime scaling into the brane background to obtain a candidate throat geometry.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Solve section-degree constraints without denominator coordinates, extract minimal divisor factors, and identify the candidate fiber. Check monodromy and matter separately before concluding non-Higgsability.

sources.title: A Note on the dS Swampland Conjecture, Non‐BPS Branes and K‐Theory

evidence.text: Does the de Sitter swampland conjecture require cancellation of torsional D-brane charge on compact spaces? The proposed test uses the positive tension of an isolated non-BPS D7-brane in a flux-stabilized Type IIA orientifold.

sources.title: The Octagon at large M

evidence.text: What geometric effect could convert the orientifold-induced runaway into a stable nonsupersymmetric vacuum when odd deformation-brane charge is added?

sources.title: A Note on supergravity solutions for partially localized intersecting branes

evidence.text: Can partially localized intersecting-brane supergravity backgrounds be constructed beyond the near-horizon approximation, and why does the Fourier construction fail for intersections such as D1⊥D5(1)?

sources.title: Space - like and time dependent branes from DBI

evidence.text: Can analytic continuation of known DBI brane excitations produce time-dependent configurations analogous to gravitational bubbles and S-branes, and illuminate brane–antibrane annihilation?

sources.title: Supergravity and world volume physics in the dual description of N=1* theory

evidence.text: Does the proposed wrapped-five-brane dual of N=1* correctly distinguish confined and screened charges, uniquely represent each massive vacuum, and reproduce its asymptotic-state scales and global symmetries?

sources.title: Black p-branes in heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can black 0- and 4-brane supergravity solutions connect previously proposed heterotic-brane throat regions to asymptotically flat space, providing further evidence for the existence of the nonsupersymmetric branes suggested by cobordism arguments?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Which EFT strings probe complex-structure-controlled RR and heterotic five-brane abelian gauge sectors?

sources.title: Getting just the standard model at intersecting branes

evidence.text: Can intersecting D-branes directly yield the three-generation Standard Model gauge group and chiral spectrum, without subsequent effective-field-theory removal of extra gauge bosons or chiral matter?

sources.title: Strings and membranes from $\mathcal{A}$-theory five brane

evidence.text: Can consistent sectionings of a manifestly U-duality-covariant five-brane Lagrangian recover conventional string and membrane actions, including their Wess–Zumino couplings, and furnish a perturbative intermediate five-brane description?

sources.title: Partially localized intersecting BPS branes

evidence.text: Can explicit analytic supergravity solutions describe one BPS brane localized at another, while retaining relative-position parameters useful for proposed bulk/boundary correspondences?

sources.title: Weak gravity (and other conjectures) with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: Three magnetic fields allow a candidate nonsupersymmetric charged sector without zero-separation tachyons, enabling a comparison between sector stability and brane repulsion.

sources.title: Towards a classification of branes in theories with eight supercharges

evidence.text: Can single half-BPS branes in supergravities with eight supercharges and coset scalar manifolds be classified through the reality properties of charge-representation weights, and how do their counts relate to wrapping rules and central charges?

sources.title: D = 4 chiral string compactifications from intersecting branes

evidence.text: How can intersecting wrapped D-branes produce four-dimensional chiral gauge sectors, satisfy RR tadpole and anomaly constraints, and accommodate three-family spectra while controlling nonsupersymmetric instabilities?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking Warped Throats and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Which rank patterns produce mobile regular branes, supersymmetric fractional-brane throats, or sectors without supersymmetric vacua? Their distinction controls the available geometric resolutions and candidate decay branches.

sources.title: Diversity in the Tail of the Intersecting Brane Landscape

evidence.text: How can supersymmetric intersecting-brane configurations and inequivalent realizations of a fixed gauge subgroup be systematically enumerated, and where does their low-energy diversity occur in the distribution of models?

sources.title: Weak gravity bounds in asymptotic string compactifications

evidence.text: Do actual BPS D3-brane particles occupy enough charge directions to satisfy the electric convex hull condition, or are non-BPS particles necessary? This window determines aspects of the required extremality geometry without settling that spectrum question.

sources.title: Open-closed correspondence of K-theory and cobordism

evidence.text: Can open–closed string duality relate D-brane K-theory charges to geometric cobordism charges, and can gauging their combined charges explain familiar tadpole cancellation conditions?

sources.title: The Landscape of intersecting brane models

evidence.text: How many supersymmetric intersecting-brane configurations realize specified gauge groups and chiral generations, and how strongly are their gauge and matter properties correlated?

sources.title: A Circle That Won't Return: The Fate of RR Fluxes and D-branes in Type 0A Tachyon Condensation

evidence.text: Within the proposed type 0A→IIA collapse of one M-theory wedge branch, determine how doubled RR fields source the tachyon and what happens to collapsing-branch fluxes and D-brane charges: decoupling, infrared screening, or an additional discharge process.

sources.title: Axions, three-forms, and M-theory

evidence.text: Can a brane construction explain the gauge origin of an axion shift symmetry, its three-form mass mechanism, and its dual two-form description within string/M-theory?

sources.title:
All-order quartic couplings in highly symmetric
D-brane-anti-D-brane systems

evidence.text: Which two-tachyon–two-gauge-field couplings reproduce brane–antibrane string amplitudes to all orders in α′, and how must earlier EFT proposals be modified?

sources.title: D-brane probes, RR tadpole cancellation and K-theory charge

evidence.text: Can anomalies on suitable D-brane probes detect RR charge constraints invisible to vacuum anomaly cancellation, including torsional K-theory charges, and determine consistent configurations where exact CFT tadpole computations are unavailable?

sources.title: Interplay of intersecting branes and consistent embeddings

evidence.text: How do consistently embedded worldvolume supergravities generate partially localized intersecting-brane solutions, and can these intersections conversely determine embedding ansätze, including bosonic and fermionic fields?

sources.title: Kinetic Mixing of the Photon with Hidden U(1)s in String Phenomenology

evidence.text: How does photon–hidden-U(1) kinetic mixing arise in type II compactifications, including supersymmetric configurations and warped flux backgrounds, and how can it survive when Stückelberg mass mixing vanishes?

sources.title: Brane boxes, anomalies, bending and tadpoles

evidence.text: Which rank assignments make finite-string-coupling brane box models consistent, and how do string consistency conditions distinguish worldvolume gauge anomalies from scale anomalies and NS5-brane bending?

sources.title: Dielectric branes

evidence.text: Construct a nonabelian world-volume action for coincident Dp-branes compatible with T-duality, and determine how external fields can polarize branes into higher-dimensional noncommutative configurations.

sources.title: Orientiworld

evidence.text: Can infinite-volume brane-world scenarios be embedded in string theory with chiral matter and quantum-induced four-dimensional gravity, potentially separating a TeV string scale from the four-dimensional Planck scale?

sources.title: RR photons

evidence.text: When can closed-string RR U(1) gauge bosons mix kinetically or through Stückelberg masses with D-brane U(1)s, and how does compactification topology determine the surviving photons and their possible phenomenological effects?

sources.title: There and back again: A T-brane's tale

evidence.text: What Abelian brane description captures T-branes when their noncommuting scalar vevs and flux become too large for the non-Abelian description, given the difficulties with a naive dielectric D(p+2)-brane interpretation?

sources.title: Dynamical tadpoles and Weak Gravity Constraints

evidence.text: Can mobile space-filling branes coexist with stuck probes under one orientifold? The shifted construction separates the space-filling twisted-tadpole requirement from the allowed charge of a lower-dimensional probe.

sources.title: Brane gases in the early universe

evidence.text: Does including fundamental branes beyond strings preserve the proposed avoidance of the initial cosmological singularity and selection of at most three large spatial dimensions? Can the resulting brane relic problem be resolved dynamically?

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the constrained anti-D3-brane vector admit an electric–magnetic dual description with the same action form and reciprocal coupling? The relevant criterion concerns on-shell equivalence, while the electric action can change under dualization.

sources.title: Why do we live in 3+1 dimensions?

evidence.text: Can intersections, reconnection and evaporation dynamically select surviving three-dimensional D-branes, allowing a braneworld explanation of our observed 3+1 dimensions within ten-dimensional string theory?

sources.title: Continuous Global Symmetries and Hyperweak Interactions in String Compactifications

evidence.text: How do arguments excluding exact continuous global symmetries extend to D-branes, and how can approximate flavour symmetries and hyperweak gauge interactions nevertheless arise in four-dimensional effective theories?

sources.title: Intersecting brane worlds

evidence.text: Can intersecting D-branes provide a phenomenological origin for chiral quarks and leptons, family replication and hierarchical couplings, while supporting a low string scale and proton stability?

sources.title: End of the world branes from dimensional reduction

evidence.text: Can dimensional reduction of a smooth cigar geometry produce an end-of-the-world brane whose dilaton-dependent tension is fixed by consistency, supplying examples beyond assumed bottom-up boundary actions?

sources.title: Comments on Brane Recombination, Finite Flux Vacua, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Do supersymmetric recombined branes exist for an unbounded sequence of negative D3 charges? The paper proposes their nonperturbative stability as a test of finite-vacua conjectures, conditional on completing the configurations into distinct vacua satisfying the conjecture's fixed bounds.

sources.title: Stability and vacuum energy in open string models with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: How do torus geometry and brane distributions control the spectrum and vacuum energy in D-dimensional orientifolds with a single Scherk–Schwarz direction? Corner backgrounds reduce the brane data to integer multiplicities paired across that direction.

sources.title: D-branes and K-theory

evidence.text: Can brane–antibrane creation and tachyon condensation explain why conserved D-brane charges belong to spacetime K-theory, including torsion charges of nonsupersymmetric Type I objects?

sources.title: Constraining Spacetime Dimensions in Quantum Gravity by Scale Invariance and Electric–Magnetic Duality

evidence.text: Which spatial brane dimensions p and spacetime dimensions D are compatible with a scale-invariant low-energy brane theory and an electric–magnetic dual brane obeying the same leading interaction law? Can these conditions characterize the dimensions and branes associated with conventional quantum gravity?

sources.title: What does(n't) K-theory classify?

evidence.text: Which versions of K-theory classify D-brane trajectories, conserved RR charges or RR fluxes, under which equivalences and background restrictions, and where do self-duality and S-duality obstruct these classifications?

sources.title: Dual D-brane actions in nonrelativistic string theory

evidence.text: How do worldvolume gauge-field dualization and T-duality act on nonrelativistic D-branes with RR couplings, and what do their dual actions reveal about nonrelativistic M-theory?

sources.title: Dynamical tadpoles and Weak Gravity Constraints

evidence.text: How do D-brane sources change the action of an ED3 wrapping a common compact four-cycle? Smearing reduces the relevant profiles to a two-dimensional transverse Poisson problem.

sources.title: On codimension-one vacua and string theory

evidence.text: Which localized codimension-one sources are compatible with string-inspired Einstein-dilaton vacua, and can their junction conditions, couplings and tensions admit a string interpretation when supersymmetry is absent?

sources.title: Dynamical Cobordism Conjecture: solutions for end-of-the-world branes

evidence.text: Can finite-distance singularities in rolling dilaton backgrounds be closed by explicit local on-shell end-of-the-world branes whose asymptotics match the original solution, and what restrictions follow for exponential couplings?

sources.title: Intersecting brane worlds on tori and orbifolds

evidence.text: How can intersecting D-branes engineer chiral, semi-realistic four-dimensional gauge theories while satisfying anomaly constraints, and how do toroidal or orbifold compactifications affect their gravitational and moduli stability?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking Warped Throats and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: This orientifold supplies an isolated DSB sector and non-isolated geometric branches. The latter become important when regular D3-branes are added.

sources.title: On BPS Branes

evidence.text: Which quantized brane charges support BPS states? The paper asks whether regular supergravity attractors predict occupancy even at small charges, and whether electric–magnetic cone duality determines the larger BPS charge cone.

sources.title: On extended supersymmetry of 4d Galileons and 3-brane effective actions

evidence.text: Can the amplitude constraints be understood through a geometric brane embedding? The reviewed induced-metric action generates DBI and Galileon terms, while boundary geometry distinguishes interactions requiring an end-of-the-world brane.

sources.title: Comment on "Braneworld Effective Field Theories -- Holography, Consistency and Conformal Effects"

evidence.text: Can strict separation of charged matter on two endpoint branes create exact accidental symmetries that would obstruct a quantum-gravitational UV completion? The toy model isolates the role of locality, field content, and the bulk gauged U(1).

sources.title: Interacting intersections

evidence.text: Can smeared intersecting-brane oxidations of lower-dimensional multicharge solutions be generalized to depend on compactification coordinates, and do the resulting interactions explain why apparent threshold constituents need not drift apart?

sources.title: Small kinetic mixing in string theory

evidence.text: Why does D3–D3 kinetic mixing cancel, does the cancellation survive nonzero C0 and brane-localized two-form couplings, and what leading nonzero mixing can internal fluxes generate in sequestered compactifications without tiny gauge couplings?

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Can a microscopic brane and geometry construction clarify the status of a BGHHS-like flat two-form period?

sources.title: Black and super p-branes in diverse dimensions

evidence.text: How uniformly can dilaton-gravity-form theories describe elementary, magnetic solitonic and nonextremal black p-branes in arbitrary dimensions, and when do extremality, supersymmetry, electric-magnetic duality and nonsingularity coincide?

sources.title: Toward realistic intersecting D-brane models

evidence.text: Pedagogical review of how intersecting D-brane compactifications generate gauge fields, chiral replicated matter and effective couplings, and how closely consistent constructions approach realistic Standard Model or MSSM physics.

sources.title: String Landscape and the Standard Model of Particle Physics

evidence.text: How can a local Standard Model brane construction be embedded in a compact, globally consistent string background?

sources.title: Three-family supersymmetric Pati-Salam models from intersecting D6-branes on rigid cycles

evidence.text: Can rigid intersecting D6-branes on factorizable tori yield consistent three-family N=1 Pati-Salam models with suitable symmetry-breaking Higgs fields, while removing unwanted adjoint moduli and permitting asymptotic freedom?

sources.title: Charge multiplets and masses for E(11)

evidence.text: Can decomposition of the E11 l1 charge representation organize lower-dimensional brane multiplets and supply an algebraic mass/tension formula consistent with known U-duality spectra?

sources.title: On the absence of supergravity solutions for localized, intersecting sources

evidence.text: Can two perpendicularly intersecting, fully localized Dp-brane stacks or Op-planes admit a supersymmetric ten-dimensional supergravity solution with a generic diagonal metric and generic symmetry-compatible fluxes?

sources.title: The complete search for the supersymmetric Pati-Salam models from intersecting D6-branes

evidence.text: Can a deterministic search exhaust the three-family N=1 supersymmetric Pati–Salam constructions satisfying the specified tadpole, supersymmetry and generation conditions, and classify their string-scale gauge coupling relations?

sources.title: 134 billion intersecting brane models

evidence.text: How many gauge-inequivalent, consistent intersecting D6-brane configurations exist on the specified orientifold, and how are they distributed over gauge-group rank and allowed complex structures?

sources.title: de Sitter Extrema and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does a solution of source-integrated supergravity equations have a fully localized counterpart with the required orientifold and brane backreaction?

sources.title: Brane gas cosmology in M theory: Late time behavior

evidence.text: Can a homogeneous M-theory universe containing supergravity particles and anisotropically wrapped M2-branes dynamically develop a hierarchy between spatial dimensions? The paper studies possible late-time outcomes, especially three large unwrapped dimensions, without determining the probabilities of the required initial configurations.

sources.title: Brane symmetries revisited: symmetries of tensile and tensionless branes in possibly degenerate metrics and their manifestations

evidence.text: Which derivative-dependent symmetries survive for bosonic tensile and tensionless p-branes coupled to metric, form-potential and dilaton backgrounds, including degenerate target metrics, and how do their conserved quantities appear in worldvolume and bulk descriptions?

sources.title: Swampland cobordism conjecture and non-Abelian duality groups

evidence.text: Could additional fields or exotic defects kill handle loops that ordinary supersymmetric 7-branes cannot contract? Could time-dependent backgrounds realize genus-zero torsion candidates excluded by the compact supersymmetric K3 discriminant budget?

sources.title: Branes and six-dimensional supersymmetric theories

evidence.text: How can brane configurations realize anomaly-free six-dimensional (0,1) theories, their proposed interacting strong-coupling fixed points, small-instanton transitions, and ultraviolet completions with gravity decoupled?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: How do higher-derivative terms and background five-branes alter heterotic EFT couplings and string charges?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can separating branes make charged objects too heavy relative to their gauge coupling?

sources.title: Dirichlet Branes and Ramond-Ramond charges

evidence.text: Can Dirichlet-branes supply the electric and magnetic RR sources required by type II string duality, with the required charge quantization?

sources.title: K theory and Ramond-Ramond charge

evidence.text: How do the embedding topology and Chan–Paton bundle of a wrapped D-brane determine its Ramond–Ramond charge, especially when the normal bundle is nontrivial, and does the result favor K-theory as the charge group?

sources.title: Emergent potentials and non-perturbative open topological strings

evidence.text: Can integrating out M2 branes ending on M5 branes capture non-perturbative open topological strings, and can an ultraviolet contribution generate classical open-string superpotential terms, providing evidence for emergence of potentials from codimension-one states?

sources.title: Some remarks on Swampland conjectures, fluxes and K-theory in IIB toroidal compactifications

evidence.text: Can a non-BPS-brane uplift remain consistent with compact-space discrete charge cancellation and stable against NS-NS-flux-mediated changes of its charge carrier?

sources.title: D-brane charges in five-brane backgrounds

evidence.text: What is the physical meaning of twisted-K-theory torsion charges in five-brane backgrounds, and when do boundary RR collective coordinates change the charge group measured at infinity from Z_k to Z?

sources.title: String Theory of Supertubes

evidence.text: Can exact worldsheet descriptions of supertubes expose near-source topology hidden by supergravity smearing and identify wrapped-brane degrees of freedom relevant to the long-string sector and approach to the black-hole threshold?

How can stable N = 1 brane objects be followed beyond the near-supersymmetric intersection EFT, and how could finiteness criteria extend to other compactifications? The paper identifies these as unresolved problems rather than supplying a general construction.

Can extremal membrane and fivebrane backgrounds support linearized gravitino hairs unobtainable by any supersymmetry transformation, carrying nonzero asymptotic supercharges, and can such modes extend to intersecting branes?
Can heterotic supergravity admit analytic black branes with multiple gauge charges, and can their perturbative instabilities identify transitions toward additional black-brane configurations?

Can a dynamical bulk three-form provide an adjustable integration constant supporting flat four-dimensional slices in an RS-II model without retuning the brane tension, and can its scalar dual have a Goldstone-boson interpretation?

What supergravity geometries describe twisted brane theories flowing across dimensions, and under which assumptions are smooth or suitably singular Randall–Sundrum and de Sitter compactifications excluded?
How do nonabelian transverse D-brane scalars modify BPS equations and stability conditions, and how can the resulting equations be related to brane-antibrane tachyons and superconnections?

Can time-dependent topological defects realize spacelike branes in field theory and string theory, and how are tachyon solitons, timelike-Dirichlet boundary states and charged supergravity solutions related?
Can slightly nonsupersymmetric intersecting branes drive separation-field inflation and recombine into a supersymmetric configuration that still contains intersecting branes?

Which intersecting-brane configurations preserve supersymmetry, how can their supergravity solutions be constructed and localised, and how do these descriptions illuminate black holes and gauge theories?

How can the conformal theory on N D3-branes at a conifold be derived from an intersecting-brane construction, and how do its geometry, global symmetries and coupling moduli appear after lifting to M-theory?

destination.title: Compactification stability and bubble geometries
destination.question: How do geometry, flux, moduli dynamics and supersymmetry govern compactification stability and bubble processes, and which neighboring questions concern different physical targets?
destination.summary: The original proposal supplies numerical membership without an independently stated scientific scope. Its membership supports a navigational family containing several mechanisms and targets, not a common decay mechanism or universal instability claim. The cards below are proposed scopes requiring independent review.

systems: Selected string/M-theory vacua and effective gravitational models
Adjacent static, time-dependent and scale-separated compactification geometries
targets: Bubble-of-nothing existence, obstructions and semiclassical actions
Competing vacuum transitions and brane bubbles
Supersymmetry, quantum stability and controlled compactification limits
regimes: Supersymmetric and nonsupersymmetric settings, kept distinct
AdS, Minkowski and positive-energy vacua where specified
Euclidean decay saddles, Lorentzian initial data and static ground states, kept distinct
assumptions: Membership and selection roles are numerical provenance, not scientific conclusions.
Topological permission, perturbative stability and nonperturbative stability are separate questions.
No universal implication from broken supersymmetry to instability is adopted.
conventions: Bubble of nothing denotes the relevant spacetime-ending compactification degeneration; external brane shells and ordinary vacuum bubbles retain separate identities.
A source-scoped singleton preserves the exact supplied question without establishing atomicity or cross-source uniqueness.
includes: Ordinary and pre-Swampland compactification and vacuum-decay work
Useful boundary comparisons and alternate homes
excludes: Treating every circle pinch as a tunneling instanton
Treating every charged bubble as a bubble of nothing
Inferring universal stability, complete control or canonical equivalence from the packet

sources.title: Universal isolation in the AdS landscape

evidence.text: Which global conditions forbid quantum bubble nucleation from perturbatively stable AdS vacua, and do explicit massive-IIA compactifications realize tunneling or an isolated landscape?

sources.title: Nothing really matters

evidence.text: Which higher-dimensional vacuum geometries admit bubble-of-nothing decay instantons, what is their semiclassical action difference, and when can spin structure obstruct the proposed decay?

sources.title: Nothing is certain in string compactifications

evidence.text: Can bubbles of nothing destabilize nonsupersymmetric compactifications even with supersymmetry-compatible fermion boundary conditions, and what topological and dynamical conditions obstruct this decay?

sources.title: Catastrophic decays of compactified space-times

evidence.text: Do Witten bubbles of nothing survive string corrections and moduli stabilization, occur generically in nonsupersymmetric compactifications, and remain absent after small spontaneous supersymmetry breaking? Does their existence establish a physical inconsistency or support a prediction of low-energy supersymmetry?

sources.title: Universal isolation in the AdS landscape

evidence.text: Local fake superpotentials are expanded around critical points. Hessian square-root choices label branches, followed by order-by-order algebraic equations; the six-scalar numerical construction uses expansion through order 15.

sources.title: Nothing really matters

evidence.text: Evaluate bulk and Gibbons–Hawking–York contributions to the Euclidean action difference. Independently formulate the circle-reduced scalar–gravity system through a Hamilton–Jacobi principal function, completing squares and imposing a zero Hamiltonian constraint to obtain first-order flows.

sources.title: Nothing is certain in string compactifications

evidence.text: At first order in α, decompose the metric perturbation into trace and transverse-traceless parts. The latter obeys the homogeneous Lichnerowicz equation; the remaining volume/dilaton perturbation satisfies ∇²ϕ^(1)=(α̂/16)R_GB². Other background moduli decouple at this order.

sources.title: Catastrophic decays of compactified space-times

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction and Weyl rescaling recast the bubble as a Coleman–De Luccia gravity–scalar problem. Numerical shooting varies the pinch-off parameter r0 to obtain undershoot and overshoot of the stabilized vacuum.

sources.title: Universal isolation in the AdS landscape

evidence.text: Single-field crossing rules, asymptotic behavior and small-curvature deformations are used to distinguish globally bounding branches, interpolating extremal walls and possible finite-radius decay channels.

sources.title: Universal isolation in the AdS landscape

evidence.text: Hamilton–Jacobi reformulation replaces the second-order wall equations with first-order flows. For flat static walls, F(a,φ)=2e³ᵃf(φ) separates the constraint and identifies f as a fake superpotential.

sources.title: Bubbles of nothing: the tunneling potential approach

evidence.text: Which modulus potentials and higher-dimensional compactifications admit bubbles of nothing, how do their core asymptotics determine physical boundary conditions, and how do BoNs compete with or become quenched relative to standard vacuum decay?

sources.title: Bubbles of Nothing and Supersymmetric Compactifications

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric circle compactifications admit the spin structure required for a bubble of nothing, and, when topology permits this channel, what dynamical mechanism suppresses their decay?

sources.title: Much ado about nothing

evidence.text: Can a nonsupersymmetric AdS quotient with a noncontractible circle decay through a bubble of nothing, and how do energy conservation, flat-space limits and a possible holographic description constrain this process?

sources.title: Domain walls, near-BPS bubbles, and probabilities in the landscape

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric walls connect landscape vacua, how does uplifting turn them into vacuum-decay bubbles, and how do irreversible decay channels change landscape probabilities?

sources.title: Quantum dynamics of supergravity on R$^3 \times$ S$^1$

evidence.text: Does minimal supersymmetric circle compactification remain quantum mechanically stable after perturbative Casimir cancellation, and how do gravitational instantons generate a superpotential, an infrared scale, and decompactification?

sources.title: Stringy Tachyonic Instabilities of Non-Supersymmetric Ricci Flat Backgrounds

evidence.text: How do spacetime spin structures enter the worldsheet description of Type II compactifications on compact Ricci-flat spin 3-manifolds, and what winding tachyons and one-loop vacuum energies diagnose their non-supersymmetric instabilities? The motivation is the conjectured relation between physical stability and special holonomy.

sources.title: Decay of Kaluza-Klein vacuum via singular instanton

evidence.text: Does relaxing smoothness of the bubble-of-nothing instanton yield finite conical-singularity contributions that lower the five-dimensional Kaluza–Klein vacuum's decay exponent, and can that change be interpreted thermodynamically?

sources.title: Gravity dual of gauge theory on S**2 x S**1 x R

evidence.text: What bulk geometries describe the zero-temperature gauge-theory vacuum on S² × S¹, how does the preferred geometry depend on circle size, and is gravitational energy bounded below at fixed conformal boundary?

sources.title: Bubble of nothing decays of unstable theories

evidence.text: Can bubbles of nothing survive stabilization of a compact dimension at positive vacuum energy, and how does their tunneling exponent behave as the false-vacuum energy approaches zero?

sources.title: Bubbles of Nothing and the Fastest Decay in the Landscape

evidence.text: Which decay route is fastest in an explicit flux landscape once radion thick-wall and gravitational effects are included: small flux steps, giant leaps, complete discharge into a bubble of nothing, decompactification, or combined flux discharge and decompactification?

sources.title: Decay of flux vacua to nothing

evidence.text: Can magnetic-flux compactifications to four dimensions decay through a smooth charged bubble of nothing in which the entire internal S² degenerates, including compactifications with AdS, Minkowski and de Sitter large dimensions?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS$_{6}$ and the swampland

evidence.text: Can a spherical D4 probe furnish a Euclidean bubble instanton in a supersymmetric or non-supersymmetric Brandhuber-Oz background?

sources.title: Tunneling potentials to nothing

evidence.text: Which modulus potentials admit bubbles of nothing, how can their core asymptotics and higher-dimensional origins be classified using tunneling potentials, and when are these decays quenched or competitive with ordinary vacuum decay?

sources.title: Bubbles of Nothing in Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can a perturbatively stabilized flux compactification nevertheless decay through a smooth bubble of nothing, and what charged source permits the compact cycle to disappear without a flux singularity?

sources.title: Transplanckian Censorship and the Local Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can electric three-form flux support a smooth, finite-size KK bubble whose compact circle reaches zero size? The reviewed initial-data family permits comparison of bubble radii at fixed asymptotic circle period and flux.

sources.title: Neutralizing topological obstructions to bubbles of nothing

evidence.text: How can dynamical charged sources or gauge fields remove flux, Wilson-line and fermion-spin-structure obstructions to bubbles of nothing, and how do these mechanisms change the leading semiclassical decay exponent?

sources.title: New Kaluza-Klein instantons and the decay of AdS vacua

evidence.text: Can a higher-dimensional sphere collapse smoothly in a flux-supported compactification, producing a finite-action bubble-of-nothing instanton that destabilizes otherwise perturbatively stable non-supersymmetric AdS vacua?

sources.title: Supersymmetry, Ricci Flat Manifolds and the String Landscape

evidence.text: Does superstring/M theory require supersymmetry below the compactification scale in stable geometric Minkowski vacua? The paper formulates necessary mathematical conditions involving compact Ricci-flat manifolds, generic holonomy and stability; it does not establish the prediction.

sources.title: Instabilities in scale-separated Casimir vacua

evidence.text: Do flux-supported, parametrically scale-separated Casimir compactifications remain on shell and stable once square-torus shape deformations, including curvature-producing perturbations, are allowed?

sources.title: Runaway dilatonic domain walls

evidence.text: When does the dilatonic coupling of a compactification's volume modulus obstruct stable domain walls, vacuum bubbles, or bubble collisions, and what replaces the intended interpolation between four-dimensional vacua?

sources.title: De Sitter decays to infinity

evidence.text: When do stabilized, positive-energy compactifications admit bubbles of nothing (BON), what controls their semiclassical action, and how do their decay rates compare with ordinary Coleman–De Luccia (CDL) and Hawking–Moss (HM) channels?

sources.title: Brane nucleation in supersymmetric models

evidence.text: How can vacuum decay combine scalar-field tunnelling with charged-membrane nucleation between flux sectors, and how do the resulting bubbles approach supersymmetric planar walls when explicit supersymmetry breaking vanishes?
